data.name: description
data.DebugDisplay: We would like your permission to measure the performance of ads you see or interact with when you play our games. By selecting ‘Yes', you give us permission to use collection of your game data and game play behaviour to help us to measure and improve our marketing campaigns. If you select ‘No’ we will not collect any of your game data or monitor your behaviour. Using a Measurement API, information such as hashed IP addresses, API versions, anonymised User IDs, timestamps, Developer API Keys, OS versions, screen resolutions, time zones, system languages, and in-game events helps us to build a better understanding of our players' interaction with both our marketing and our games. You can change your mind and decide to stop sharing your data at any time. If you want to stop SEGA from analysing your data, you can do so by going to Preferences → Advanced → General, and updating your preference.
